name: OBI
summary: Community ontology for describing scientific investigations: assays, devices, protocols, objectives and data transformations. It defines more than 2,500 terms and is used for biomedical and laboratory data integration.

verification.notes: The current release version is not stated on the website or repository front page.

engineeringUses: Describing laboratory assays, instruments and protocols consistently across studies
Annotating experimental data for integration and reuse
